explication: Space Rabbit is a native macOS menu-bar utility for reducing animation when navigating Spaces and Mission Control. Its main workflow intercepts keyboard or trackpad input and requests fast transitions through synthetic Dock gestures; separate paths handle app-switch auto-follow and optional Mission Control transitions. The README documents these capabilities, while the sampled entry-point excerpt confirms shortcut loading, menu creation, automatic update checks, and application observers. Several implementation details are unsampled, so documented feature links use the README as evidence.
